options.content:
**All PVCs share one disk.**
k3s uses the local-path provisioner, so every claim is a
directory on the node's root filesystem (`/dev/sda2`).

They therefore all report the *same* utilisation — it is
the root disk's, not the claim's. A PVC here has no
independent size limit, and one runaway writer fills
every volume at once.

Watch **Root disk** in the health strip; the per-PVC
rows are only useful for spotting which claim is
growing, via the write rate rather than the level.
